headline: DeepSeek's v4.1-flash hits all-time high; OpenAI tumbles
summary: DeepSeek's newest model claimed an all-time token-share record at 10.1%, vaulting two spots to #1 and dragging its provider to 24.8% overall—a gain of 2.3 points in a single day. Meanwhile, OpenAI hemorrhaged 6.3 points, with its flagship gpt-5.6-luna dropping four ranks. The top three providers (DeepSeek, Tencent, Zhipu AI) now command 52.1% of the market.
highlights: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20260910 sets all-time token-share record at 10.1%
DeepSeek provider share surges to 24.8% (+2.3% in one day)
OpenAI plummets 6.3 points to 11.3%, losing its #5 model four ranks
Top 3 providers hold 52.1% combined; top 5 hold 69.9%
Three new entrants: Google's gemma-4-26b, Qwen's qwen3.8-27b, Meta's muse-spark-1.3
NVIDIA's nemotron-3.5-lightning jumps 12 ranks in a day
